name: Solliden Farmstead
summary: At Solliden Farmstead, human farmers still tend pumpkins in western Tirisfal Glades, just north of Deathknell. These native Lordaeronians survived the Plague of Undeath, a rare sight in northern Lordaeron, and hold fiercely to their soil beneath the Scarlet Crusade’s shadow.

sections.title: A Defiant Remnant
sections.body: Solliden Farmstead’s fields still yield healthy crops while much of Lordaeron lies in ruin and rot. The surviving human farmers are traumatized and insular, living beneath the watch of Scarlet Crusade patrols from a nearby tower. They defend their home with fierce hostility, striking at outsiders who come near, whether Horde or Alliance.

sections.title: Eyes in the Undercity
sections.body: Forsaken rising from Deathknell see Solliden Farmstead as both a threat and a resource. The Royal Apothecary Society wants its pristine pumpkins as prime organic material for testing and brewing the New Plague. Forsaken officers such as Deathguard Simmer send fledgling recruits to raid the fields, steal pumpkins for Apothecary Johaan in Brill, and teach the living a lesson.

faq.q: Why are there living humans farming in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: The Solliden farmers are native humans of Lordaeron who miraculously escaped infection during the Third War. Scarlet Crusade patrols from a nearby tower shield them, and they keep cultivating their land rather than flee their ancestral home.

faq.q: Why are the Solliden farmers hostile to Alliance players?
faq.answer: The fall of Lordaeron left the farmers paranoid, bitter, and unwilling to trust anyone beyond their circle. Shielded by the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, they see trespassers as threats or infected scavengers and attack Alliance and Horde travelers alike.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want pumpkins from Solliden Farmstead?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society needs fresh, uncorrupted organic matter to test and refine its New Plague. Pumpkins growing in Solliden’s soil are untainted hosts for developing toxic strains.

faq.q: Who is Deathguard Simmer, and why does he target the farm?
faq.answer: Deathguard Simmer is a Forsaken officer stationed near Deathknell. He sends fledgling Forsaken to raid the farm, steal ten pumpkins for Apothecary Johaan in Brill, and teach the humans and their Scarlet Crusade protectors a lesson.

angles.text: For a newly risen Forsaken, Solliden Farmstead is an immediate lesson in realpolitik: living Lordaeronians despise what you have become, while the farm offers raw material for Apothecary toxins and a possible southern beachhead.
Seeing living humans till Lordaeron’s soil may bring you hope, but these isolated survivors hate Stormwind’s citizens as they hate the undead.
